books.title: Stupid Fast
books.author: Geoff Herbach
books.teaser: Just before his sixteenth birthday, Felton Reinstein has a sudden growth spurt that turns him from a small, jumpy, picked-on boy with the nickname of Squirrel Nut to a powerful athlete, leading to new friends, his first love, and the courage to confront his family's past and current problems.

books.title: Dear Manny
books.author: Nic Stone
books.teaser: While running for junior class president at his university, Jared falls for his opponent, who has a similar platform based on equity and inclusion, and processes his feelings by writing letters to his deceased friend Manny.

books.title: A History of Hope
books.author: James Fraser
books.teaser: From the words of ordinary people to the country's founding ideals, hope for a better future has always been part of the American story.

books.title: Wonder Woman: Bitter Rivals
books.author: Greg Rucka
books.teaser: Wonder Woman turns to Batman for help investigating a murder that soon reveals a connection to billionaire Veronica Cale.
